column3: “Egypt” is rendered “the Egyptians” in “the heart of the Egyptians.”
“Disturbed” is rendered “demoralized,” and “the mutterer” as “ghosts of the dead.”
“Will be low” is rendered “will thin out,” and “wither” as “rot away.”
“Will be ashamed” is rendered “will be utterly dejected.”
“Its foundations” is rendered “the pillars of Egypt.”
“Counsel foolish” is rendered “has become stupid,” and NASB adds “men.”
“A deliverer and one who contends” is rendered “a Savior and a Champion.”
“He will be entreated” is rendered “He will respond.”
“Will serve … Assyria” is rendered “will worship with the Assyrians.”
